testId: testim-migrated/tests/admin/sales-rep/sales-rep-account-association.spec.ts > Admin - Sales Rep > Z10-TC-31696 sales rep popup on add account lists only reps of the selected store

scenario.summary: On Add Account, with store A (which has a sales rep) selected the Sales Rep lookup lists store A's sales rep; with a store that has no sales reps selected it lists none.
steps: Go to Accounts and Users > Accounts > Add Account.
Select store A (@storeA.name) in Store Name; click the Sales Rep search icon; search the popup for @rep.fullName; close the popup.
Select the store without sales reps (@storeNoReps.name) in Store Name; click the Sales Rep search icon; read the popup list.
assertions: Store A: @rep.fullName is listed in the popup
Store without sales reps: the popup lists no sales rep (No records found.)
evidence: Story Z10-38546 (SalesRep - Phase 2, account association), data-needs analysis work/stories/Z10-38546/analysis.md sections 3-4 and answers in section 6.
Test case Z10-TC-31696 (AIO export): precondition (a store with sales reps, a store without), steps 1-8 and expected result.
FSD section 2 (Add Account: the Sales Rep lookup displays only Sales Reps associated with the selected Store) and section 3 (popup).
Store without sales reps: STORE_WITHOUT_SALES_REPS (pending), no store param (any such store); its name is the value the test selects.
Store MaxwellsHardware: the store the migrated suites run on (store A), as in the Phase 1 tests.
Admin session: the suite's saved admin session (admin.setup.ts), a credential, not a need.
Lookup disabled without a store and its validation message are cases Z10-TC-31694 and Z10-TC-31695, not part of this case.
storeNoReps excludes store A (exceptPortalId = @storeA.portalId): store A gets its rep at run time, so it cannot be the store without reps.
